summary: Virax Biolabs Group Limited filed a Form 6-K reporting it increased the maximum aggregate offering amount under its existing At The Market Offering Agreement with H.C. Wainwright & Co., LLC to $2,070,060.20, excluding $3,658,152 of shares previously sold. The September 4, 2026 prospectus supplement amends prior filings dated January 22, 2024 and September 30, 2024, and forms part of the Form F-3 registration statement. Ogier provided an opinion on the legality of the share issuance. This is a routine shelf takedown amendment, not a special situation.
